APIs.name: DutyKey.duty_id / natural_slot
APIs.effect: Canonical identity exact8008 fields; strict UTC text, no normalization, no cut/claim in identity; duplicate natural slots reject

APIs.name: advance_stage
APIs.effect: Pure CAS precondition over same immutable duty/revision/active typed ref; registered->cap/final or cap->final; returns new state/history; no persistent CAS or APPLIED

APIs.name: aggregate
APIs.effect: Complete provided same-account USD-scale tuple, <=1000; exact unique duty/natural slot and legal single-active stages; gross P/U/N/H, no N netting

APIs.name: decompose
APIs.effect: Requires funding_components=EXCLUDED on supplied base values; accrual=baseAccounting-P+N, risk=baseRisk-H, available=risk-baseIM-orderReserve; cash raw=cash-realSpotF-H, clamped max(raw,0); conditional arithmetic not valuation/admission

APIs.name: backing_precondition
APIs.effect: Own fixed P only, other H unchanged; prior confirmed obligations must be externally supplied clear; F<=max(cash-ownP,0). WAIT preserves every P/U/N/H; eligible output is projection only, never actual payment/APPLIED/ACK

APIs.name: preview_wait / validate_wait_records
APIs.effect: Explicit immutable shared-action policy/first-start/deadline/highwater/revision/attempts; no clock; unknown query outcome consumes one supplied dispatched attempt; no new duty/claim budget. WAIT or sticky DEFAULT_REVIEW without changing holds

APIs.name: unsupported_request
APIs.effect: Closed unsupported operation names rejected; unknown requests never default to0 or authorize anything

fixed_numeric_domain.usd_scale: native int2..8, exact same scale required everywhere; no conversion/rounding API
fixed_numeric_domain.money_inputs: native int not bool, absolute units<10^38; nonnegative P/U/N/F/IM/MM/reserve; signed base equity/cash
fixed_numeric_domain.totals_upper_bound: Each P/U/N/H <=1000*(10^38-1); one active representation per duty, so H=P+U fits this bound, not i64
fixed_numeric_domain.derived_values_upper_bound: Absolute conditional equity/availability/cash expressions <=4000*10^38; checked exact Python integers, never clamp except public spendable max(raw,0)
fixed_numeric_domain.negative_and_equal: F<=max(cash-ownP,0) permits F0 negative-cash preview; no IM/MM equality authorization. Equal versions/refs required for pureCAS

refs: Typed EXPOSURE/CAP/FINAL_CUT shape+same-duty/scope linking only; no authentication/content lookup/actual obligation proof
base_input_precondition: Supplied base accounting/risk values explicitly exclude P/N/H; base risk already includes genuine spot F once. Values are externally provided facts, not evaluated by this module.
wait_policy: Required exact versioned no-default fields from8008; stable action identity and approved policy identity belong to one supplied record, not individual duty/claim; first deadline/highwater and counts never reset; persistence/outbox/real time/auth remainD2
